title: How Do Yelp Ads Work? Complete Guide to Yelp Advertising (2026)

facts.fact: The vendor describes Yelp Ads as a pay-per-click (PPC) advertising platform designed to help local businesses appear at the top of search results.
facts.quote: Yelp Ads are a pay-per-click (PPC) advertising platform designed to help local businesses appear at the top of search results

facts.fact: The vendor states that Yelp Ads operate on a cost-per-click model in which businesses set a monthly budget and are charged only when users click on their listing.
facts.quote: businesses set a monthly budget and are charged only when users click on their listing

facts.fact: The vendor's guide was published on July 28, 2025.
The vendor's guide is titled as a complete guide to Yelp advertising for 2026.
The vendor says industries such as plumbing, water damage restoration, legal services, and healthcare consistently perform well on Yelp Ads, though it gives no performance figures.
facts.quote: Industries such as plumbing, water damage restoration, legal services, and healthcare consistently perform well
